responsibility: Implements dead and redundant store elimination for SSA GIMPLE memory operations. It walks basic blocks in reverse order, models writes with ao_ref descriptors, uses virtual-def single-use chains, alias queries, post-dominance, and optional byte-level liveness tracking to classify stores as live, partially dead, dead, or redundant, trims or deletes dead mem* calls and assignments, and cleans up trivially dead defs, PHIs, and EH edges exposed by the removed stores.
same_name_distinction: This source file implements the dead and redundant store elimination pass itself, including reverse CFG walking, ao_ref-based store analysis, liveness classification, trimming/deletion of dead stores, and cleanup of exposed dead defs/PHIs/EH edges. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-dse.h, which only declares support types and helper entry points such as dse_store_status and store-classification/deletion helpers, this file contains the pass algorithm.
